newsitem.title: USA: Lomas former unit emerges from Chapter 11.
newsitem.headline: Lomas former unit emerges from Chapter 11.

text.p: Lomas Financial Corp said on Tuesday that the Chapter 11 plan of its former subsidiary, Lomas Mortgage USA Inc, was confirmed by the Bankruptcy Court in Wilmington, Deleware and that Lomas Mortgage emerges from Chapter 11 with a new name, Nomas Corp.
Lomas said that creditors' committee for Lomas Mortgage had reached an oral agreement with the committee for Lomas Financial settling intercompany disputes.
The company said that, while the parties had reached an agreement in principal there may not be complete agreement regarding the terms of the settlement.

Lomas said distributions to creditors could be delayed for prolonged periods if the intercompany disputes are not reduced to a signed agreement, or if other large claims that have been filed are not resolved.
